name: rugspull
description: A disclosed rugpull parody protocol on BNB Smart Chain.

scripts.test: npm run build -w @rugspull/contracts-ts && npm run test -w @rugspull/economics && npm run test -w @rugspull/web && npm run test -w @rugspull/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @rugspull/economics && npm run build -w @rugspull/contracts-ts && npm run build -w @rugspull/web && npm run build -w @rugspull/api
scripts.dev:cloudflare: npm run build -w @rugspull/web && npm run dev -w @rugspull/api
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: npm run build && npm run deploy -w @rugspull/api
